LanguageData.CC_Storyline_Host_Hungry: {WHO} went short today: when they were hungry, the stores had nothing for them, so they ate what they brought.
LanguageData.CC_Storyline_Host_NoRoof: {WHO} did not all have a bed today: each of them needs a free bed or sleeping spot under a roof.
LanguageData.CC_Storyline_Host_Neither: {WHO} went short today: when they were hungry, the stores had nothing for them, and not all of them had a bed or sleeping spot under a roof.
LanguageData.CC_Storyline_Sick_Status: Still ill: {ILL}, {INBED} of them in a bed. Well and gone home: {WELL}. Died: {DEAD}.
LanguageData.CC_Storyline_Kin_Asking: The families are asking what the colony will do with the dead.
LanguageData.CC_Storyline_Kin_Burying: Buried: {BURIED} of {COUNT}. The colony's people need to dig the graves beyond the gate and carry the bodies in.
LanguageData.CC_Storyline_Kin_Carrying: The families are carrying their dead home.
LanguageData.CC_Storyline_Impact_HandDead: The families from {FACTION} carry the bodies home.
LanguageData.CC_Storyline_Impact_BuryDead: Graves are marked out beyond the gate. The colony's people dig them and carry the bodies in, while the families from {FACTION} wait for about a day.
LanguageData.CC_Storyline_Herd_Penned: In a pen or a barn: {PENNED}. Still here: {HERE} of {TOTAL}.
LanguageData.CC_Storyline_Herd_Winter: Still here: {HERE} of {TOTAL}, {PENNED} of them in a pen or a barn. Hay and kibble in the stores: {STORED} nutrition. They eat about {NEED} before the end, less where they can graze.
LanguageData.CC_Storyline_Relic_Chase: {RIVAL} is running for the edge of the map with the relic.
LanguageData.CC_Storyline_Relic_Judging: The pilgrims are waiting for the colony to decide what happens to {RIVAL}.
LanguageData.CC_Storyline_Relic_CampStatus: The relic is in {RIVAL}'s camp on the world map. Bring it home to the colony.
LanguageData.CC_Storyline_Relic_Searching: The pilgrims are searching for the thief.
LanguageData.CC_Storyline_Relic_ShrineAt: The relic will be set down beside the {SHRINE}.
LanguageData.CC_Storyline_Relic_NoShrine: The colony has no shrine yet: an altar, a shrine, a ritual spot or a work of art.
LanguageData.CC_Storyline_Relic_Visit: {COUNT} pilgrims of {FACTION} came to see their relic at the colony's shrine and left an offering of {SILVER} silver.
LanguageData.CC_Storyline_Relic_Missing: Pilgrims of {FACTION} came to see their relic at the colony's shrine and found it gone. They hold it against the colony.
LanguageData.CC_Storyline_Relic_Home: The year is over. {WHO} of {FACTION} has come to take the relic home, and thanks the colony for keeping it.
LanguageData.CC_Storyline_Relic_Deed: the relic kept at the shrine
LanguageData.CC_Storyline_Impact_HandThief: {RIVAL} goes with the pilgrims, to answer to their people.
LanguageData.CC_Storyline_Impact_LetThiefGo: {RIVAL} is free to leave once able to walk.
LanguageData.CC_Storyline_Truce_Witness: Time someone of the colony has spent with both envoys: {HOURS} of {NEED} hours.
LanguageData.CC_Storyline_Fighters_Coming: Fighters of {OTHERPEOPLE} reach the colony's land within {DAYS}.
LanguageData.CC_Storyline_Fighters_Asking: The fighters are resting at the edge of the colony's land, waiting to go on.
LanguageData.CC_Storyline_Fighters_Gate: The fighters are waiting at the gate.
LanguageData.CC_Storyline_Fighters_Fight: The fighters are forcing their way in.
LanguageData.CC_Storyline_Fighters_Crossing: The fighters are crossing the colony's land.
LanguageData.CC_Storyline_Impact_Pass: The fighters of {OTHERPEOPLE} cross the land and attack {FACTION}, and the two peoples go to war.
LanguageData.CC_Storyline_Impact_PassBrief: they attack, and there is war
LanguageData.CC_Storyline_Impact_Warn: {FACTION} are ready for the fighters of {OTHERPEOPLE}, and the attack fails. {FACTION} trust {OTHERPEOPLE} less than before.
LanguageData.CC_Storyline_Impact_Stop: The fighters wait at the gate for two hours, then turn back. About {CHANCE}% of the time they force their way in instead, and it is a fight.
